values.agent: Aludel drafts the plan and tasks

dreamer.label: Dreamer
dreamer.summary: Describe what you imagine. Agents handle the implementation details.
dreamer.detail: Focus on the big idea. You won't be asked to micromanage.

planner.label: Planner
planner.summary: Shape the vision, roadmap and finer details without writing the code.
planner.detail: You act as product or project manager. Agents implement and you review.

tinkerer.label: Tinkerer
tinkerer.summary: Hands-on and self-directed. No AI required.
tinkerer.detail: Aludel is your home base for plan, code, commits, design and previews. Delegate to agents later if you choose.
